---
description: these naming conventions should always be applied when designing names
---

- Capitalised abbreviations in camel case or pascal case should be treated as words, e.g., `HttpRequest` not `HTTPRequest`.
- :x: plural form if there is a suffix
- Pascal case for classes, interfaces, types, and enums, and vue module names
- Camel case for functions, variables, and private fields (with underscore prefix)
